Product Sync - Meeting Minutes
Date: Oct 3, 2026
Attendees: Chen Wei, Chen Wen, Noah Grant
Note taker: Noah Grant
Decisions
1. Ship ordering in the next release; payments follow in a separate release.
2. Raise the checkout timeout alert threshold to 450 ms.
Discussion
Chen Wei reported that weekly active users grew 15% after the loyalty launch. Chen Wen raised concerns about support load during the rollout and asked for a staged release.
Action items
Action | Owner | Due
Staged rollout plan | Chen Wen | Friday
Alert threshold change | Chen Wei | Monday
Release notes | Noah Grant | Tuesday
